backup.production_rule: Usage learning (spec docs/s118/SPEC-usage-learning.md). inventory_items gains usage_baseline_per_turnover, usage_baseline_note, usage_state (baseline|learning|measured), last_refill_at, last_refill_qty, usage_updated_at. New table public.inventory_usage_intervals (RLS on, no grant to any API role). Internal, no grants: record_inventory_anchor_v1, s_inventory_usage_recompute_v1, inventory_usage_quarterly_reset_v1 (pg_cron inventory-usage-quarterly-reset, 1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 20:00 UTC). get_inventory_usage_kpi_v1: authenticated, gate read_operations. Hooks (one block each, any error becomes a WARNING): s_apply_inventory_count_core_v1 (md5 3937a6da154fe1ed60471689833f96e2), record_inventory_receipt_v1 (7cb59453f37eeeeb15b1e9f4c4ffa883), apply_inventory_purchase (48082c76263e15517d733c65f7eb3ccc), s_inventory_receipt_apply_v1 (4f09a8ae895d945703f60a96705413e7). get_inventory_catalogue_v1 (00ca41d933a5c5a9c4498cff682e7844) gains seven keys. consumption_per_booking is widened from numeric(10,2) to numeric(10,4) before the seed. An AFTER DELETE trigger on inventory_purchases recomputes the refill mark when a receipt is undone. The migration seeds 22 baselines and sets consumption_per_booking where it was the 2.00 default or null, then replays the telegram_count audit rows through the anchor: the 27 Oct rows (note: Count of 16 Oct printout) anchor at 16 Oct 08:21 Manila (D-351), the 18 Nov rows at 18 Nov (expected: 3 accepted intervals of 33 days and 17 turnovers - Laundry Detergent consumed 23, Hand Soap 2, Insect Spray 1, learned rates 1.5926, 0.1074, 0.0556 today; Coffee rejected as unrecorded restock). Each stay is counted once per item by construction: inventory_usage_intervals.turnover_keys holds the stay keys an interval claimed (checkout_date, or the session id when there is none), and a new interval claims every unclaimed stay whose earliest date falls between the item's first anchor and the count, so a late report, a correction either side of a count and a back-dated count never count a stay twice. New internal helper s_inventory_received_date_v1 (no API grant) dates a purchase: purchased_at defaults to the UTC date, so a value equal to the UTC date of created_at is read as the Manila date of entry. A purchase entered after the previous count and received on that count's Manila day rejects the interval with reason 'same-day purchase' (the anchor still moves and its stays are claimed). New table public.s120_usage_item_snapshot (RLS on, no API grant) holds consumption_per_booking of every item before the seed; the rollback restores from it. A recompute writes inventory_items only when the state or the rate changes. The daily-digest stock alert threshold was settled on the waves side (D-375), not here.
backup.notes: Additive. No signature, grant or existing result key changes; five function bodies are cut by patching the live body after an md5 guard (55000 when production moved). Writes: the new columns and table, consumption_per_booking and usage_state on the seeded items. Stock, purchases and the audit log are not written. consumption_per_booking is read by daily-digest (runway) and telegram-expense (short when qty < rate): the deployed daily-digest names stock only when an item is out, so these rates silence nothing there; in telegram-expense only the 'may run short' note moves (D-375). Deploy order: SQL only; apps may read the new catalogue keys and the KPI RPC afterwards.

rollback.safe_until: Always, with data loss by design: every interval, learned rate, seeded baseline and refill mark is dropped, and consumption_per_booking returns to the value each item held before the release, restored from public.s120_usage_item_snapshot (taken before any seed; the script stops with 55000 if the snapshot is missing, then drops it). The script takes the hook block back out of the four functions and the seven keys out of the catalogue, with an md5 guard on each body, before it drops anything, then drops the trigger, the received-date helper and the intervals table and narrows consumption_per_booking back to numeric(10,2).

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261120_s120_usage_learning.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) must be 3937a6da154fe1ed60471689833f96e2 (s_apply_inventory_count_core_v1), 7cb59453f37eeeeb15b1e9f4c4ffa883 (record_inventory_receipt_v1), 48082c76263e15517d733c65f7eb3ccc (apply_inventory_purchase), 4f09a8ae895d945703f60a96705413e7 (s_inventory_receipt_apply_v1) and 00ca41d933a5c5a9c4498cff682e7844 (get_inventory_catalogue_v1), and public.inventory_usage_intervals, public.s120_usage_item_snapshot and public.s_inventory_received_date_v1 must not exist, and consumption_per_booking must equal the pre-release value for each item (read from a backup taken before the apply). Roll back any app that reads usageState or get_inventory_usage_kpi_v1 first.
